Project overview

Villa Sumalee is a small completed complex of two-storey townhouses in Rawai, southern Phuket, built in 2017. The roughly 144 sqm homes have two bedrooms and three bathrooms and share a communal pool.

Facilities & amenities

  • Communal swimming pool
  • 24-hour security
  • CCTV
  • Car park
